what: A `backoff` builder got an option or an attempt number it cannot use.
fix: Pass finite, non-negative numbers: `jitter` from 0 to 1, a whole number to `upTo`, attempts from 1.

what: `for` or `run` got a name that is not in the presets (only reachable from untyped JS).
fix: Use a name you passed to `definePresets(...)`. Types catch this in TypeScript.

what: No execution or queue slot was available; no callback ran.
fix: Shed load or explicitly retry after capacity becomes available.

what: Execution was cancelled before work could continue.
fix: Stop retrying; begin new work only under a new owning signal.

what: The circuit is open; no callback ran.
fix: Wait for a half-open attempt or explicitly handle the refusal.

what: The owned deadline expired; the callback may still need to finish cancellation.
fix: Pass the attempt signal to work and reconcile effects before retrying.
